name: Gasthof Kirchenwirt
beschreibung:
Located in the heart of Thiersee, Gasthof Kirchenwirt welcomes travellers with comfortable guestrooms and delicious Tyrolean dishes. It serves as a vibrant meeting place for visitors and locals alike.

Picturesque Lake Thiersee, historic Kufstein, and hiking routes up Mount Pendling are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Kirchenwirt in Thiersee offers timeless village inn culture in the picturesque Kufsteinerland.
